name: 17557 · New Holland, PA
findings: ZIP 17557 (New Holland) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17557 (New Holland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17557 (New Holland) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
